task: binary confusion detection from facial video (DAiSEE, ANY cut)

input.name: clip
input.preprocessing: MediaPipe BlazeFace crop, 10% pad, largest face, centre-crop fallback; ImageNet-normalised CHW float32

export.note: the exporter warns about dynamic batch axes with LSTMs; parity was measured at batch 1/2/4 and held, and the backend serves batch 1 regardless

honest_performance_test.external_reference: Bosch et al. IUI 2015 facial confusion AUC 0.649 (N=137, in the wild)

ablation.note: unfreezing layer4 OVERFIT (12M params on 4852 clips); frozen wins

limitations: Binary: confusion only. Boredom, frustration and engagement are NOT detected.
Weaker than the behavioural channel (AUC 0.641 vs 0.747).
Trained on DAiSEE, a different corpus and different people from the behavioural model, so the two together do NOT constitute a demonstrated fusion gain.
